response.sql: WITH site_ratio AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS zone, s.insurstat AS status, AVG(m.facetresmm * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS mesh_count FROM sites s JOIN scanmesh m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), status_avg AS (SELECT status, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM site_ratio WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL GROUP BY status), kept AS (SELECT r.zone, r.status, r.ratio, r.mesh_count, a.avg_ratio FROM site_ratio r JOIN status_avg a ON a.status = r.status WHERE r.ratio > a.avg_ratio) SELECT status AS insurstat, AVG(ratio) AS avg_kept_ratio, COUNT(*) AS kept_sites, AVG(ratio - avg_ratio) AS avg_excess FROM kept GROUP BY status
